maria: Quick heads-up — hitting a weird race in streaming SDK where a chunk boundary splits the final JSON object (EOF) and our parser returns partial JSON -> gets treated as closed stream, causing retry logic to double-send.

maria: Repro steps: start a streaming completion with long tokens; interrupt network (tcp kill) during last chunk. Attached minimal log below.

maria: log:
```
recv chunk: b'{\"id\": \"abc\", \"choices\":[{\"text\":\"...\",\"finish_reason\":null}'
recv chunk: b']}}\n'
parser: unexpected end of data -> raise PartialJSON
retry: immediate retry triggered (non-idempotent) -> duplicate tokens
```

liam: hmm. Which client? py or js?

maria: python async client (aiohttp) and also repro'd in node when using native stream parser.

aseem: I think parser treats EOF as terminal even if buffer contains incomplete object. We had a fix previously that checked for trailing newline. Could be different sea of edgecases with chunking.

liam: Proposed fix: on EOF, if JSONDecodeError and buffer looks like truncated object (endswith '\"' or 'null' ...), don't mark stream terminal — emit `incomplete_chunk` event and let retry handler decide after short backoff. Add metrics for 'partial_json_eof'.

maria: @liam can you open a small PR? add an integ test that simulates split object across chunks and an artificial socket close.

liam: will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/824

liam: snippet of test I'm planning:
```
# fake socket yields chunks then closes
await feed_chunks([b'{\"a\":1, \"b\":', b'2}'])
assert stream.events.contains('message')
```

kate: quick note for rollout: mark as minor patch; requires client bump and avoid server changes. Q: does this affect dedupe logic on server? @aseem

aseem: server dedupe relies on request ids, so duplicates are possible but handled. still want minimal client fix first.

devex-bot: Deploy preview for liam/stream-eof-fix is ready — build 72 passed :white_check_mark:

liam: ok assigning to @kate for release coordination.

kate: I'll schedule a canary tomorrow 09:00 PT, will follow with email to infra. please add CHANGELOG entry.

maria: thanks all — ping me on thread after PR merged, I'll run reproducibility script and close issue.

liam: merged -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/commit/abc123

maria: verified in canary, partial-json metrics now 0. Going to close.

kate: closing in release notes. :tada:
